tutor.title: AI Tutor — work processes
tutor.subtitle: Question-and-answer with an experienced instructor: each agency's own work processes. The tutor explains a step, asks a question, evaluates your answer and corrects it. Voice mode available.
tutor.stepsHint: Tick the steps you have mastered.
tutor.legalNote: Article numbers come only from the verified list. Check the current wording on lex.uz.
tutor.quizHint: Answer any time — the explanation appears instantly.
tutor.errInterrupted: The tutor's reply was cut off. Please send your message again.
tutor.errNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
tutor.micDenied: Microphone access denied. Allow it in the browser settings.
tutor.micError: Speech could not be recognised. Try again or type your answer.
tutor.micUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
tutor.liveHint: Hands-free: the tutor speaks its reply, then listens to you automatically
tutor.introHow: The tutor briefly explains each step and asks you one question. Answer by typing or by voice.
tutor.placeholder: Type your answer or tap the microphone…
tutor.completeRule: To complete: at least {turns} Q&A turns and all quick-check questions.
